meta.phase: SC-4 — Object-linked annotations and evidence access
meta.purpose: Canonical explanatory copy for directly pickable rendered components. Geometry, coordinates, evidence measurements, and bibliography remain authoritative in their existing scientific records; this file is the validated annotation presentation layer.
meta.scope: Generic titin education through the retained human skeletal N2A-containing Q8WZ42 reference model.

components.label: Titin
components.lay_text: Titin is the giant elastic protein highlighted in pink. One molecule spans a half-sarcomere from the Z-disc to the M-band, acting as both an extensible spring and a thick-filament-associated scaffold.
components.expert_text: The axial topology and Q8WZ42 domain order are constrained, but the smooth tube and its transverse I-band route are presentation proxies rather than a resolved molecular trajectory.
components.scope: Human canonical skeletal N2A-containing titin (Q8WZ42); one representative half-sarcomere molecule.
components.render_meaning: Pink region-linked tubes and the thin continuity trace identify one continuous titin path; tube width and unresolved transverse routing are not molecular dimensions.

components.label: Myosin thick filament
components.lay_text: The thick filament is the central myosin-based backbone. Titin’s A-band portion lies along its outer surface, while myosin heads project outward where they can interact with nearby actin.
components.expert_text: The axial length, bare-zone interval, and crown measurements are evidence-classified separately. The smooth backbone cylinder is a schematic envelope and does not reproduce native filament surface density.
components.scope: Retained mammalian striated-muscle filament context in the human skeletal reference model.
components.render_meaning: Blue cylinders locate the thick-filament backbone; the central head-free interval is the bare zone, not the width of the M-band.
not_claimed: that titin runs through the filament core

components.label: Myosin heads
components.lay_text: Myosin heads project from the thick-filament surface in repeating crowns. They provide contractile context here, helping show that titin occupies the filament periphery rather than its central core.
components.expert_text: Two-segment S2–motor proxies use the measured local geometry and crown periodicity retained by the context-detail layer; inter-filament phase and the primitive surface shape remain schematic.
components.scope: Conserved mammalian thick-filament context; structural measurements include cardiac preparations and are not used to redefine skeletal titin coordinates.
components.render_meaning: Light-blue paired capsules represent resolved head skeleton directions at crown levels; they appear only when the periodicity is screen-resolvable.
not_claimed: exact mutual crown phase between neighbouring filaments

components.label: Actin thin filament
components.lay_text: Actin thin filaments extend inward from each Z-disc and surround the thick filament. Their overlap with myosin changes with sarcomere length while their modeled filament length stays fixed.
components.expert_text: The retained reference length and axial placement are separately sourced; the smooth cylinder is a coarse filament envelope and omits regulatory proteins deferred by the scope contract.
components.scope: Mammalian striated-muscle context in the retained skeletal reference model.
components.render_meaning: Green cylinders mark thin-filament paths and their changing overlap with the thick filament; cylinder diameter is a rendering proxy.
not_claimed: a universal thin-filament length for every muscle
resolved actin subunits in the overview

components.label: Thin-filament helical twist
components.lay_text: The paired green helices reveal actin’s long-pitch two-stranded twist when the camera is close enough to resolve it. They are detail on the same thin filament, not extra filaments.
components.expert_text: The crossover repeat is measurement-derived, while phase, tube radius, and continuous helical surface are schematic. Individual actin subunits and regulatory complexes are intentionally absent.
components.scope: Mammalian thin-filament structural context; used only as a local morphology cue in the skeletal reference model.
components.render_meaning: Two narrow helices 180° apart depict the measured long-pitch crossover only above the aliasing threshold.
not_claimed: an exact helical phase shared by every filament

components.label: Z-disc
components.lay_text: The Z-disc marks the sarcomere boundary. Thin filaments anchor here, and titin’s N-terminal Z1–Z2 region joins a local protein network that transfers tension between the filament systems.
components.expert_text: The overview slab is only an envelope. Its close-up uses a heterogeneous skeletal thin-form motif and does not combine relaxed small-square and activated basketweave lattices.
components.scope: Local vertebrate skeletal Z-disc context applied to the retained human skeletal titin reference without claiming an isoform-specific complete lattice.
components.render_meaning: The gray slab locates the boundary; close-up filament and crosslink proxies carry the supported local topology while the slab becomes visually subordinate.
not_claimed: a resolved complete lateral route for titin

components.label: α-Actinin
components.lay_text: α-Actinin crosslinks neighboring actin filaments inside the Z-disc. The cyan connectors appear only in the Z-disc close-up, where they show local organization without turning the disc into a uniform grid.
components.expert_text: Guided mode uses topology-only heterogeneous connectors. Evidence mode may expose the sourced doublet spacing, while connector paths and complete network register remain schematic.
components.scope: Fast skeletal thin-form Z-disc evidence used as local structural context, not a universal vertebrate Z-disc lattice.
components.render_meaning: Cyan connector proxies mark α-actinin crosslink relationships; exact doublets are restricted to Evidence mode and resolvable zoom.

components.label: Telethonin (T-cap)
components.lay_text: Telethonin helps anchor titin at the Z-disc by forming a compact sandwich with two opposing titin Z1–Z2 fragments. The local glyph shows this two-titin-to-one-telethonin topology.
components.expert_text: The antiparallel 2:1 binding topology is structure-supported. The displayed span and its connection to the unresolved in-situ lateral network are schematic rather than an atomic fit.
components.scope: Human isolated Z1Z2–telethonin complex topology shown within a schematic in-situ Z-disc context.
components.render_meaning: The pale connector sits within the finite overlap of two antiparallel titin Z1–Z2 proxies; both titin directions remain visible.
not_claimed: a measured display length for the glyph

components.label: M-band center
components.lay_text: The M-band is the sarcomere’s center, where thick filaments and the C-terminal ends of titin are integrated. The narrow ring marks only the exact midpoint coordinate.
components.expert_text: The marker has zero adopted axial width and is distinct from the 160 nm thick-filament bare zone. No M1 density is inferred from the retained averaged maps.
components.scope: Mammalian striated-muscle midpoint and M-band integration relationships in the retained skeletal reference model.
components.render_meaning: A zero-width purple ring marks the midpoint; sparse close-up crosslinks provide relationship context without an opaque M-line slab.
not_claimed: that the bare-zone width is the M-band width

components.label: M-band crosslink context
components.lay_text: Sparse purple connectors show that neighboring thick filaments are integrated by an M-band protein network. They provide structural context for titin’s C-terminal anchorage without forming a solid wall.
components.expert_text: The component relationships are supported, but the retained connector count, paths, and exact identities are deliberately schematic; M1 is omitted and no precise myomesin or OBSL1 coordinate is asserted.
components.scope: Vertebrate skeletal M-band relationship context; exact human Q8WZ42 crosslink coordinates remain unresolved.
components.render_meaning: Sparse purple segment proxies connect neighboring thick-filament slices only in the resolved M-band close-up.
not_claimed: exact crosslink protein identity for each connector

components.label: Folded titin domains
components.lay_text: Repeated bead-like forms represent titin’s folded Ig-like and fibronectin-type III domains. Reusing a few validated shapes keeps the domain architecture readable without pretending every domain surface is known atom by atom.
components.expert_text: Domain identity and order follow Q8WZ42. Instanced archetypes are never stretched; changes in titin extension are expressed by spacing and disordered-chain length, not deformation of folded domains.
components.scope: Folded-domain architecture of human canonical Q8WZ42 in the retained skeletal N2A-containing model.
components.render_meaning: Instanced capsules and ellipsoids encode domain class, position, and orientation; primitive surfaces are archetypes rather than unique molecular meshes.
not_claimed: known azimuth for every folded domain
